title: Local Metric3 High Value Outliers
dataSources: Nextdoor posts (`nextdoor:post`), Ring Neighbors alerts (`ring:neighbor`), neighborhood watch logs (`neighborhood:watch`), and local alerts (`local:alert`).
app: Nextdoor post exports, Ring Neighbors alerts, neighborhood watch logs, and local emergency alert feeds ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=local:metric3 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in local metric3 (3) events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme local metric3 (3) records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It times the unusually high or low value moments in your local metric3 (3) history.
